Record final pixel coordinates to 0.01px where available; record uniform source-to-canvas transform and SHA256 after export. Never copy another pose's coordinates.

items.anatomy_requirements: Complete head/ears, torso/hips, source-authored limbs, feet/tail and relevant hands; palms/grips must not be obscured by charge, trails, sheet text or another pose. Do not reconstruct covered anatomy. Match this entity's anatomy only; non-humanoids do not gain hands/feet. Floating entities retain their hover treatment.

hands_paws_requirements.primary: Measure actual contact/launch point if the entity has one; null for absent anatomy
hands_paws_requirements.secondary: Measure actual prop/support contact only where present; null otherwise
hands_paws_requirements.support: Preserve entity-specific anatomy; no humanoid hands added to creatures or machines

projectile.origin: actual mouth/limb/weapon/emitter for named attack; null if non-projectile

hands_paws_requirements.foreground: Use complete existing anatomical/prop silhouette; no mandatory extra hand image for non-playable actors

items.feet_tail_requirements: Complete canonical supporting anatomy and tail visible; lowest ground-bearing anatomy at target baseline. For hovering bodies measure hover reference; do not add feet. No doubled or clipped appendages.
items.eye_head_target: Face active target in normal combat; recoil/hurt/recovery must not reverse target-facing. Noncombat look follows named activity.
items.movement_body_weight: State-specific anticipation/weight transfer/commit/settle; preserve source aspect ratio and shared baseline; only explicit attack root motion crosses lanes. Movement must show actual locomotion, not idle relabelled.
items.weapon_contact_rule: Measure actual contact/launch point if the entity has one; null for absent anatomy
items.primary_grip: MEASURE_FROM_DELIVERED_PIXELS if anatomy/contact exists; otherwise null
items.secondary_grip: MEASURE_FROM_DELIVERED_PIXELS if anatomy/contact exists; otherwise null
items.support_hand_requirement: Preserve entity-specific anatomy; no humanoid hands added to creatures or machines
items.foreground_fingers_requirement: Use complete existing anatomical/prop silhouette; no mandatory extra hand image for non-playable actors

string_arrow_projectile_requirement.origin: actual mouth/limb/weapon/emitter for named attack; null if non-projectile

equipment_layering_order: string/nocked arrow or casting charge (separate runtime where applicable)
items.temporal_vfx_separation_rules: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
allowed_baked_elements: Permanent canonical markings, outfit, intrinsic Core colouring; intrinsic entity anatomy/equipment only as declared
compatibility_requirements: Preserve established authored equipment/props for this entity; no interchangeable proxy.
Preserve all current clocks, save/economy/input semantics
acceptance_criteria: Matches the exact dedicated identity/registered entity panel; no species, silhouette, colour, marking, outfit or proportion redesign
Exact independently authored state and facing; not an idle/strike renamed to fill another cell
Required canvas, full silhouette, clean straight-alpha RGBA, no text/background; uniform scaling only
Measured anchor sidecar and matching co-registered layers; no guessed palms or reconstructed occluded anatomy
Native phone 1080x2340 and tablet 1200x1920 review at actual presentation scale; hands, feet, tails and equipment remain readable
Register only exact approved state/facing/family after parser/canonical guard/weapon-fit review; preserve existing gameplay clocks, balance, saves and touch behaviour
Phone1080x2340/tablet1200x1920 safe-area and letterbox cases: full pet/props visible, no UI overlap
Tap pet greets once; dragging/scrolling never greets, equips, places or purchases
No Home action leaks into ATTACK/shop/reward controls
All6 companions rest/greet in both facings with correct prop/contact and no identity drift
Grounded4 use cushion; hovering2 may use ledge; no invalid pet/slot placement

Unknown save IDs/older saves migrate safely; no item/reward duplication
Main Hub→separate Home→Leave/Back→Main Hub remains valid; Hub NPCs/stations stay in Hub
rejection_criteria: Identity drift or use of rejected boards
Missing/doubled/warped anatomy, clipped silhouette, hidden or floating contact
Unsafe mirroring or nonuniform scaling
Baked interchangeable equipment, labels, shadows or temporal FX
Wrong canvas/path/sidecar, inferred contact pixels or placeholder/reference card
Native staging, fit or face-target failure; technically valid PNG is not visual acceptance
items.measurement_method: On the final exported canvas with origin top-left, +X right/+Y down, measure palm contact centres (not wrists), Core/eye centre if present, actual supporting anatomy ground boundary, pivot, alpha bounding box, and launch/contact anchors. Ground Y is the boundary below the last occupied supporting pixel. Exclude shadow, lifted feet, FX and speckles. Record final pixel coordinates to 0.01px where available; record uniform source-to-canvas transform and SHA256 after export. Never copy another pose's coordinates.
importer_registration_work_required: Validate PNG/layers and sidecar first; delivery is not runtime acceptance
Convert interchange sidecar to existing manifests; do not expect automatic new-field loading

Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.
Add explicit movement/defeat/victory/activity/named-boss selectors only where current importer lacks them; never alias idle/strike
Run exact native state/facing/weapon fit, canonical guard and parser QA before closing this slot
items.why_open: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. Neutral exports cannot substitute for movement/strike/hurt/defeat; an asymmetric view cannot be mirrored; source palms and support layers cannot be invented. Existing proxy/intro presentation is not an approved articulated state export; written regional canon constrains the eventual asset.
items.support_layer_policy: One combined foreground PNG includes primary AND support/paired fingers; split support layer only if combined order cannot work. Split is an alternate delivery, not another required-file count.
items.pose_blueprint: Same NPC seated with complete hips/legs/feet and chair/contact documented; character only, furniture separate from body unless exact intrinsic prop restriction declared.
